title: minimal vendor-overlay and multi-distro handoff for air-gapped installer
author: Sasha Patel
release_notes: Adds a minimal vendor overlay and distro-specific handoff hooks for air-gapped installs. Includes a lightweight OCI index generator, terraform registry-mirror improvements, Helm registry-proxy opt-in, and documentation for on-prem handoff flow.
description:
Motivation: Customers operating in fully air-gapped on-prem environments asked for a smaller, opinionated artifact that makes it easy to hand off only the images and manifests required for their chosen OS distribution and registry topology. Large vendored bundles are expensive to transfer and maintain; this change introduces a minimal 'vendor-overlay' concept plus per-distro handoff hooks so operators can produce slim, verified bundles for Ubuntu/Alma/Rocky/Bottlerocket and mirror only the necessary artifacts.

Summary: This PR implements: 1) a vendor-overlay layout under installer/airgap that encodes per-distro selectors and an OCI index generator that outputs a delta-aware, sparse index; 2) terraform/registry-mirror updates to support regionally-scoped pre-seeding and an option to publish a signed tarball of the overlay; 3) Helm chart additions to support a registry-proxy sidecar (opt-in) and manifest rewrites during bootstrap; 4) small installer CLI hooks to produce a per-distro handoff bundle and verification step for image checksums; 5) docs and an integration test that validates a minimal handoff flow in CI.

What changed (high level):
- installer/airgap/overlay/schema.md: documents the vendor-overlay format and distro selectors.
- installer/airgap/generator/index-gen.go: new lightweight OCI index generator with sparse manifest output and checksum manifest.
- installer/airgap/hooks/handoff.sh: per-distro handoff wrapper (Ubuntu, Rocky, Alma, Bottlerocket).
- terraform/modules/registry-mirror/main.tf: add 'preseed_scope' variable and 'signed_overlay_tar' output, plus improved timeouts for large uploads.
- helm/redwood/templates/registry-proxy-deployment.yaml: opt-in sidecar config and rewrite template.
- docs/private/airgap/handoff.md: step-by-step operator guide and verification checklist.
- tests/airgap/integration/minimal_handoff_test.go: end-to-end smoke test mocking a local registry and verifying index sparsity and checksums.

Commits (summary):
- c1e3b2a add vendor-overlay schema and docs
- a8f5f6d implement index generator and sparse manifest output
- 4b2d9f1 terraform: allow signed overlay tarball and preseed scope
- d7c11a0 helm: registry-proxy opt-in and manifest rewrite helpers
- 7f9a3c4 add handoff shell hooks and klog-based verification step
- b3c0f88 tests: minimal handoff integration test and CI profile

Files changed (representative): ["installer/airgap/overlay/schema.md", "installer/airgap/generator/index-gen.go", "installer/airgap/hooks/handoff.sh", "terraform/modules/registry-mirror/main.tf", "helm/redwood/templates/registry-proxy-deployment.yaml", "docs/private/airgap/handoff.md", "tests/airgap/integration/minimal_handoff_test.go"]

Testing & CI: Initial CI run flagged lint failures in go formatting and a flaky test assertion. Fixes applied in two follow-ups: format corrections and an improved registry mock that retries on transient connection errors. CI matrix covers ubuntu/rocky variants for the integration job; all checks passed on final run (unit, gofmt, helm-lint, terraform fmt/validate, integration smoke).

Review timeline & discussion (condensed):
- Avery: requested split of the terraform change into a separate commit to make the registry outputs easier to audit.
- Sasha (author): split the terraform change and added docs to explain why the signed tarball is optional and how it interacts with KMS.
- Miguel: requested narrower image lists in the overlay generator and suggested deterministic ordering for the generated index. Implemented: index-gen sorts manifests and includes a reproducible manifest ordering flag.
- Priya: asked for an explanation of Bottlerocket hooks; added a section in schema.md and a minimal validation script.

Backwards compatibility and migration: This PR is additive and opt-in. Existing airgap bundles continue to work. Operators who opt into the vendor-overlay flow should run the provided verification script on their mirror and may use the signed_overlay_tar output for offline transfer. No API-breaking changes.

Merge outcome: Merged via squash on 2024-12-02 after approvals from reviewers and successful CI.

Notes for release: The handoff flow and docs were added to the private-installer release notes under 'airgap improvements — vendor overlay & distro handoff'. Recommend enabling the new 'preseed_scope' terraform variable in test environments before enabling in production.
